thread:
nina: Quick bug: REST /auth/keys returns `rotatable: false` for service keys but Go SDK's Key struct omits it so onboarding sample assumes rotatable=true.
leo: can you paste REST + SDK output?
nina: REST:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/keys/svc-123 | jq
# => {"id":"svc-123", "rotatable": false, "created_at": "2026-02-10T12:00:00Z"}
```
SDK (go):
```
client.GetKey("svc-123")
// => &Key{ID:"svc-123", CreatedAt: time..., /* no Rotatable field */}
```
samir: looks like serializer drops boolean false via `if v { ... }` guard.
leo: CI: sampleapp/tests/onboard/test_key_rotation.py::test_non_rotatable_key failing (1 failed).
ci-bot: failing test logs at ci://artifacts/2102461990/key_rotation.log
nina: fix: preserve explicit false. Change filter to `if v != nil` in go (and `if v is not None` in python). Add unit tests for false booleans.
samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/223 - adds Rotatable bool on Key, changes serializer, adds test + changelog.
leo: also add quickstart note: "do not assume keys are rotatable by default; check rotatable flag".
ci-bot: CI passed for sdk-go/pull/223 on linux-amd64, queued merge.
nina: will update onboarding sample to gate rotation UI. Thanks!
